properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 25 at 1:39PM EDT until August 25 at 2:45PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
SMWJAX

The National Weather Service in Jacksonville has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL out 20 NM...

* Until 245 PM EDT.

* At 139 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located over Crescent
Beach, or 9 nm south of Saint Augustine, moving east at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Butler Beach, Marineland, Crescent Beach, Saint Augustine Beach,
and Palm Coast.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes. If your vessel is
caught offshore, immediately secure for heavy weather. Ensure all
crew members are wearing USCG approved Type I life jackets and
nonessential crew are below decks. Deploy jack lines and harnesses if
available. Check life saving equipment, including batteries on
handheld radios, for readiness.

properties.description:

Coastal waters from St. Augustine to Flagler Beach FL out 20 NM...

of producing winds to around 30 knots. This thunderstorm was located
over Crescent Beach, or 10 nm south of Saint Augustine, moving east
at 20 knots.
properties.instruction:

waves, and lightning strikes. Boaters should seek safe harbor
immediately until this storm passes.

properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Indiana...Illinois...

River.  At New Harmony, the river is forecast to crest around at 15.7
feet early Friday and then fall below flood stage early Sunday
morning.

Illinois side.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM CDT Tuesday the stage was 15.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 15.7 feet
early Friday morning. It will then fall below flood stage early
Sunday morning.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
